title: Aforpa
description: aforpa.fr zoominfo.com/c/aforpa/427085810 Aforpa French electrical engineering & installation contractor based in Roissy-en-France (next to Paris-CDG airport) — founded 1965 (current SAS registered 1978), specializing in high-power electrical works (HTA/BT networks, lighting) and industrial automation for airports, power plants, tunnels, telecom and residential towers. Its verified credentials: RATP certificate Q19 (electrical works for Paris transport — tunnels/stations) and registration on SFR's contractor registry (telecom power infrastructure). Headcount ~100–250, revenue est. €30–60M (private, undisclosed).
